Thanks for choosing Redwood for the upcoming integration. To get HelioDynamics into our vendor master and enable PO routing, please complete the attached intake and return the following items:

- Signed W-9 (or local tax equivalent)

I've attached the Helio master intake to save you time. If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign link for the W-9.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.
